intro.text: The Company was originally incorporated in Delaware on October 20, 2021 under the name Alset Capital Acquisition Corp. The Company was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses (the “Business Combination”). The Company consummated the Business Combination on January 9, 2024 and changed its name from “Alset Capital Acquisition Corp.” to “HWH International Inc.” The Company is an early stage and smaller reporting company and, as such, the Company is subject to all of the risks associated with early stage and emerging growth companies.

lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: The remaining 20% interest in Alset F&B One was initially measured at its fair value of $ 54,961 on the date of deconsolidation, which became the initial basis of the equity method investment.
The F&BH carrying amount of investment in equity method - related party on Alset F&B One was $ 75,383 and $ 60,708 as of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively.

The Company anticipates investing $ 1,173,000 in the JV Company through Hearty Nova Limited, with CGH investing $ 1,127,000 in the JV Company (such investment amounts reflect the parties’ relative ownership).

On September 11, 2026, the Company entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement with Smart Dynamics Technology Limited in order to purchase Hearty Nova Limited, a British Virgin Islands limited company, which the Company would use to facilitate this project through a joint venture co-owned by Hearty Nova Limited and China Gas Holdings.

The increase in stockholders’ equity during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was attributable primarily to the $500,000 investment by Alset Inc., the Company’s then-majority stockholder, described in Note 10, the settlement of the Company’s obligation to D. Boral Capital LLC described in Note 6, and the closing of the $10,000,000 financing described in Note 10.
